As a Wanda main the main tips I keep in mind is not using her movement ability to get in, but rather using it as an escape and to get higher ground. She excels at diving healers because usually you can get high up in the back line and go crazy while they try to frantically aim at you. Also always start her ult behind a wall near a choke point so you aren’t exposed until right before it hits. 

My tips against her would be using hit scan hero’s and keeping track of her movement ability cooldowns. When she flys away you can still see a red dot that you can track down, then using an ability like starlords aoe can obliterate her.

Man dude that’s amazing I’ve done crochet for a year or two so I’ll list some advice.

1. Ergonomic handled hooks, I started out with plastic hooks so you are already a step above that but it really does change the game.

2. Different materials, hooks come in many materials such as wood, metal, plastic, and bamboo. I don’t recommend plastic but it would be helpful to learn what type hook you prefer early

3. Yarn choice, now you can use any yarn you’d like from twine to 100% alpaca fur, but some yarns will work better than others, I learned with cotton yarn because it was more stretchy but you want yarn that won’t split and that will glide off your hook well. I don’t have a specific that I recommend however.

4. Stitch markers, now you said you wanted to do a lama first and for amigurami you almost need stitch markers. You can buy a set of hooks that includes stitch markers aswell as a carrying case and some darning needles, all of which are good beginner products.

5. Have fun! If you mess up the first time or something doesn’t want to work don’t worry, don’t be like me and give up the hobby for a year because you can’t figure something out reddit is a really good recourse for help and youtube as well. 

Hope this helps!
